release: prepare 0.24.1

Replace the canceled 0.24.0 release with a patch release whose SQLite-only feature matrix passes independently of Yandex Music.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

persistence: gate Yandex migration test by feature

Keep the SQLite-only CI lane independent from Yandex Music types while retaining the migration test in Yandex-enabled and all-feature builds.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

release: prepare 0.24.0

Publish the default-enabled Yandex Music integration and the accompanying TUI fixes as the next minor release.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

yandex-music: add authenticated source integration

Add the optional, default-enabled Yandex Music source with private OAuth-token storage, My Wave recommendations, catalog search, playback, reactions, downloads, artist and album navigation, adaptive artwork, and artist Wikidata details.

Cover offline reaction replay, file persistence, feature matrices, release packaging, provider parsing, and TUI interaction with deterministic mock-based tests.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

tui: separate artwork from following details

Reserve one stable blank row below fitted artwork and its adjacent action rail so metadata remains visually distinct without jumping after image decode.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

thumbnails: avoid blank enlarged-artwork frames

Keep the existing screen visible while enlarged terminal artwork loads or advances through its protocol-clearing frame, and request an immediate redraw for the image frame.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

tui: remove Select mode from the details panel

Keep text selection available through t and Esc while reclaiming the right-panel row for source-specific actions and artwork.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

release: prepare 0.23.0

Advance the package version for the responsive artwork-side action rail and its wide, narrow, and shared-panel regression coverage.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

tui: place detail actions beside artwork

Use a responsive spaced action rail when the panel can preserve useful artwork dimensions. Keep the established compact layout on narrow or short panes and reclaim full description width below the shared block.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>

release: prepare 0.22.0

Advance the package version for the validated playback, Wikidata, comments, detail-layout, and thumbnail improvements shipped together in this compatible release.

Co-authored-by: OpenAI ChatGPT <noreply@openai.com>
